market_outlook.short_term: Bond yields remain the dominant force. Expect continued equity volatility as yields test 4% globally. US-China truce provides a 3-month risk-off window. Oil above $103 keeps inflation sticky. Nasdaq may pull back from record on yield pressure. Yen intervention at 160 could trigger FX volatility. Fed's Barkin comments suggest at least one more hike, pressuring rate-sensitive sectors.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains structurally positive but bond market skepticism on AI debt suggests a 2027 correction risk. Energy transition (nuclear, renewables) supported by $100+ oil. India and emerging markets benefit from capital market maturation. Housing market faces 12-month headwind from elevated rates. GLP-1/biotech pipeline expansion continues. US-China relationship normalizes gradually post-January truce.
